author: Claude Opus 5.5 for Daniel Rosehill
status: assumed: illustrative per-request token shapes for common batch jobs, not measured from real runs
units: tokens per request; output includes hidden reasoning tokens (they bill as output)

cache_assumptions.cacheable_prefix: tokens identical at the start of every request (system prompt, instructions, schema, few-shot examples, shared document). Prefixes are kept >= 1024 tokens because OpenAI and Anthropic do not cache shorter prefixes; profiles whose shared part is below that are given 0.
cache_assumptions.write_price_when_unpublished: billed at the normal input price (automatic caching, no write premium)
cache_assumptions.unverified: OpenRouter does not state that requests inside one batch hit each other's cache. Treat cached figures as the best case.

profiles.name: Classification / labelling
profiles.example: sentiment, topic or spam label per row; instructions + few-shot examples shared, short item, one-word or tiny JSON answer

profiles.name: Structured extraction
profiles.example: pull fields from invoices, CVs, listings into a JSON schema; schema + examples shared

profiles.name: Document summarisation
profiles.example: one summary per article or transcript; instructions too short to cache

profiles.name: Many questions over one long document
profiles.example: same contract, codebase or report in every request, different question each time

profiles.name: LLM-as-judge / eval grading
profiles.example: rubric shared, candidate answer + reference vary, short score and rationale

profiles.name: Translation / rewriting
profiles.example: glossary + style guide shared, segment translated or rewritten at similar length

profiles.name: Synthetic data generation
profiles.example: persona/schema/examples shared, short seed varies, long generated sample

profiles.name: Reasoning-heavy solving
profiles.example: maths, code or planning problems with reasoning on; most output is hidden reasoning
